limitations: The corpus covers in-bounds integer sources, scale/translate mappings, all composite modes, color spaces, alpha types and clips; counts include no-ops.
Nearly integer deferred mappings, scaled shadow foregrounds, rotated layers, further spatial chains, SVG graphs, boolean shadows, large sigma, tiling and native bridges remain.
The canonical Linux browser typecheck uses available Skia development files and does not prove Skia-free compile/link/run.
